summary: @ornikar/kitt2 preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes shipped obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Tamagui/React component library but ships a preinstall dropper. `package.json` scripts.preinstall invokes `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<arch>.zip` into a temp directory, chmods the extracted binary executable, and runs it against a shipped 727KB file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunBinary, [math_init.js], { stdio: 'inherit' })`. `math_init.js` is a `// @bun @bun-cjs`-tagged bundle whose body is a rotated string-array with hex-mangled identifiers (`MmgoCP`, `etDiOOB`, `JqTtnbZ`, `WV8StW` rotator over a ~1000-entry mixed hex/string array); it is not source-mapped to anything else in the package and bears no relation to the declared React component library. Executing an obfuscated bundle under a downloaded alternate runtime at `npm install` time delivers arbitrary code to the installer's machine and evades Node-focused sandboxing. The purpose mismatch, the alternate runtime, and the obfuscation together are the install-time-rce fingerprint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
